ALL THREE ITEMS LANDED, AND THE ONE THING WORTH READING FIRST IS A REFUTATION OF THE FIX SHAPE ALL THREE PRIOR AUDITS AGREED ON. y_capacity's N1, z_tok_cap's item C and the shipped correction in src/capacity/api.py:281 all state the repaired ground as 'EITHER NEGATIVE CAN LOWER A CAP'. That is itself false for CAP_LIFT. derive.lift_to is cap + max(int(floor), int(frac x cap)), so with floor >= 0 the max is >= 0 at EVERY cap and the result is never below the cap it was handed -- 30,225 (cap, frac<0, floor>=0) combinations, 0 lowerings; the two real routes are BOTH negative at a cap above zero (lift_to(12,-0.5,-100) = 6) and CAP_LIFT_MIN alone negative at a cap BELOW zero (lift_to(-100,0.5,-1) = -101 against lift_to(-100,0.5,0) = -100, 5406 lowering cells, every one of them at cap < 0). The same sentence in capacity/api.py is not mine and is filed with an exact replacement.
